handoff_corrections: Both betting layouts are supported when settlement and prediction units match; original match-only handoff was corrected.
primary_implementation_repairs: Bounded Windows directory-publication retry for winerror 5/32/33, both save paths.
fixture_corrections: Identity MultiIndex fixture names matched its five levels.
Browser checks explicitly open collapsed figure panels and inspect decoded Plotly arrays.

limits: All new calculations, fits and accounting use synthetic data; no real football pilot or predictive-performance claim.
No search, scheduled refitting, strategy execution, feature-importance implementation or package installation.
Live Jupyter frontend trust behavior is unverified; fresh-kernel execution and saved Lab HTML are verified separately.
Histories, ratings, cutoffs and fold-aware state preparation remain upstream responsibilities.
Callers own custom metric identity, eligible decision inputs, meaningful policy/configuration and matching training/report provenance.
The full suite retains the existing pandas FutureWarning; notebook execution retains the existing Windows ZMQ selector warning.
Windows retry behavior is bounded and verified; the intermittent locking root cause is not established.
